title: Andy almost takes someone out of his book
note: Andy's own exchange, M21 test notes (2026-11-02): 'No, keep her' got 'She is now safe right there in your book', then 'Like I said, she is still right there in your book' three times before she slept. The address-book talk. The bench's book is empty, so this reads how she talks, not whether the book works.

memory.name: Andrew
facts: Has a friend named Sarah, who is in the address book.
Has a brother named Mike, who is in the address book.

turns: Mary, who have I got in my book?
Do I still have Sarah in there?
Okay. What about my brother Mike, is he in there?
I need to send him a card for his birthday next month.
Not yet. I'll get to it later.
How do I change somebody's phone number in there?
What's the difference between a nurse and a CNA anyway? I always forget.
All right, that's all I needed.
